summary: Named on two Georgia lookout lists as a tower in Wilcox County; no source found says whether it still stands.

evidence.supports: Tower list: Browning tower in Wilcox County, coordinates 31.91272,-83.25581
Page carries a Google map revision stamp dated 22 March 2016
Forest Lookouts Georgia index names Browning, Wilcox County, and gives nothing more
Wikipedia: Browning is an unincorporated community in Wilcox County
evidence.quote: Browning is an unincorporated community in Wilcox County

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only two lists name this tower (the tnlandforms Georgia tower list and the Forest Lookouts Georgia index); no register, dated, descriptive or newspaper source was found. Build date, design, staffing, status and access are unknown, so the story runs short (about 90 words, under the 120-word guide floor) and should be extended only if archival sources turn up. Not reached: gfc.state.ga.us history page (timed out), savannahnow.com 2006 fire-tower article (403). Two web searches gave no tower-specific result. The tower list's elevation column carries no stated unit and is not used. The line's 'datasheet BS0933' code is not explained by the list and is not used. Wikipedia is cited only for the name of the community. Nothing was attempted on site access.
